title: Havering: candidate stores and walking reach

walk_definition.unit: Output-area population is counted when its snapped centroid is within the network-distance threshold.
walk_definition.limitations: Original approximate centroid-based analysis. Geographic centroids and nearest-network snapping reproduce the submitted method. Whole output-area polygons are context, not boundaries of reachable addresses. No individual walking behaviour is observed.

provenance.process: Reconstructed offline from the original cached OSM response and notebook procedure. Historical graph size, snapped candidate nodes, selected-area counts and population totals match saved outputs exactly. No calibration or demand model was rerun.
sources: Original OSMnx cached boundary and walking-network response
provenance.geometry: Output-area boundaries simplified8m, borough10m and streets2m for display in British National Grid, then reprojected to WGS84. Coordinates rounded to6 decimals.
provenance.attribution: Walking network and borough boundary: © OpenStreetMap contributors. Supermarket data: Geolytix. Output areas and population: supplied coursework data.
